title: AAR named among TIME’s America’s Growth Leaders 2027
body_markdown:
**Wood Dale, Illinois** — AAR CORP., the leading parts, repair, and software platform in the aviation aftermarket, is proud to announce its inclusion on the America’s Growth Leaders 2027 list, a distinguished ranking honoring companies demonstrating exceptional growth performance, financial stability, and stock performance. This recognition is presented by TIME and Statista, global leaders in data analysis and industry benchmarking.


Being named to TIME’s America’s Growth Leaders 2027 list reflects AAR’s expanding market presence, strong financial foundation, and shareholder value generation. Inclusion in this elite group denotes sustained success, resilience through market fluctuations, and the ability to create lasting impact in the competitive global landscape.


“AAR is pleased to be named among TIME’s America’s Growth Leaders for 2027. This accolade recognizes the effective execution of our growth strategy and our disciplined capital allocation approach,” said John M. Holmes, AAR’s Chairman, President and CEO. “As we continue to enhance our capabilities and broaden our market presence, we remain focused on creating value for customers and delivering long-term returns for shareholders.”


For more information on AAR, visit


[aarcorp.com](https://www.aarcorp.com/en/) .


**About AAR** AAR is a leading global aerospace and defense aftermarket solutions company with operations in over 20 countries. Headquartered in the Chicago area, AAR supports commercial and government customers through three primary operating segments: Parts Supply; Repair, Engineering, and Software; and Government Solutions. Additional information can be found at


[aarcorp.com](https://www.aarcorp.com/en/) .


**About Statista** **** Statista publishes hundreds of worldwide industry rankings and company listings with high-profile media partners. This research and analysis service is based on the success of statista.com, the leading data and business intelligence portal that provides statistics, relevant business data, and various market and consumer studies and surveys.
